resources.name: Norm-conserving pseudopotentials for Ru and O

access.notes: Use norm-conserving pseudopotentials from SSSP library or QE pseudopotential database.
Space group P4_2/mnm, a=4.5149 Å, c=3.1156 Å, internal parameter u=0.3057. Ru at (0,0,0); O at (u,u,0) and equivalents. Use GGA equilibrium geometry.
